annotations.title: Israeli Self-Employed Pension & Training-Fund Benefit Ceilings

description: Calculate the deduction and credit ceilings for a self-employed person's pension-fund and training-fund contributions for the tax year, under the Income Tax Ordinance (ss. 47, 45א and 17(5א)). Reports each ceiling independently — it does not allocate a given contribution between deduction and credit, and it does not include the additional deduction available on amounts paid above 12% of eligible income (s.47(ב)(1)) or the amit-mutav track (s.47(ב1)). Approved tax year: 2024. Not tax advice.

annual_income.description: Annual self-employment income the deduction/credit ceilings are based on (לפני ניכוי זה), in NIS

pension_contribution.description: Amount actually paid in the tax year to a pension fund (קופת גמל לקצבה), in NIS

tax_year.description: Tax year of the contribution. Approved tax years: 2024. Any other year is refused.

training_fund_contribution.description: Amount actually paid in the tax year to a self-employed training fund (קרן השתלמות לעצמאים), in NIS
